horses.spotlight_comment: No shortage of pace with Miss Rainbow (second choice) and last year's winner Birkenhead just two that like to let rip. Both need firm consideration but the suggestion is FORTUNATE STAR (nap), a previous C&D winner who has been in a good vein of form on AW. Let's Go Hugo, a head behind the selection when fourth in this last year, might reward each-way support at likely bigger odds.[Richard Russell] Page 1 spotlightcatterick 22.04.26

Rotokura Belle showed bright speed and plenty of determination when winning a C&D handicap two weeks ago. She holds solid claims on her return visit but NAANA'S SHADOW looks a viable alternative. Katie Scott's new recruit was still in contention when squeezed out inside the final furlong on her recent stable debut and she should be sharper with that run behind her.[Paul Smith] Page 2 spotlightcatterick 22.04.26

Tide Lines needs a cursory market check on this belated debut but decent juvenile hurdler Lord may prove a bigger fly in the ointment. He could go well on his switch back to the Flat but this will probably be fought out by turf debutants MYTHICAL VALENTINE and Cranachan. There was little between the pair last time but the selection may have a touch more physical scope for improvement.[Richard Russell] Page 3 spotlightcatterick 22.04.26

Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race) £8,000 Total Race Value RTV 7f For 3-5yo fillies & mares, which are EBF eligible, which are in Bands B, C and D Weights 3yo 9st 2lb; 4-5yo 10st 1lb Penalties each race won 7lb (Sellers and Claimers excluded for the purposes of penalties) Penalty value 1st £4,320 2nd £2,028 3rd £1,014.40 4th £507.20 GOOD Trainer Jockey SP OR TS RPR Enduring Story 3 9-2 Mrs R Carr James Sullivan 100-1 - - - She has finished a well-beaten last in both AW runs this year (7f); switch to turf not enough to tempt. Got The Booty 3 9-2 T Ward NON-RUNNER 75 31 - Improved with each of her three starts (all 6f), recording an RPR of 73 when second of six (front two clear) at Southwell 13 days ago; open to further progress and this easy 7f should be in range; sets the standard. Stella Lucente 3 9-2 J Morland Daniel Muscutt 5-4 - - 78 Runner-up in two 7f maidens at Lingfield (AW), the latest 26 days ago after a 205-day absence; now tackles a race confined to her own sex for the first time and she looks set to make another bold bid. Borjina 3 9-0 E Bethell Kevin Stott 6-4 - - 69 Encouraging fourth in a 7f novice at Newcastle last September; now tackles her own sex and she returns from seven months off with her stable in fine form; leading player. Cotai Starlight 3 9-0 Katie Scott Darragh Keenan 10-1 - - 70 Similar form in two runs, the latest her stable debut 13 days ago (6f, Tapeta); has 5.5l to make up on Got The Booty on that run so improvement is essential. Le Puy 3 9-0 L Russell & M Scudamore William Pyle (3) 20-1 - - - 20-1 for her Ayr debut last September (6f, soft) and dropped away to be beaten 22l; should do better in time but others look stronger in this field. Soda 3 8-12 G Tutty Connor Beasley 6-1 - - - 4,000euros yearling; ninth foal; sister to 7f/1m winner Crossford (including 2yo/AW/Hong Kong;

97), half-sister to four winners including So Suave (7f-8.5f including 2yo/AW; 96), Star Story (1m4f AW; 82) and Coloane (1m/8.6f; 69); dam 7f 2yo winner (92); enough paper appeal to warrant a market check in this field.

Borjina (second choice) and STELLA LUCENTE are open to progress. The former returns with Ed Bethell in cracking form but Stella Lucente has run two good races against male opponents and can take advantage of the drop into a fillies' event.[Paul Smith] Page 4 spotlightcatterick 22.04.26

Vince Le Prince may reverse recent C&D placings with Evocative Spark on the forecast faster ground and he rates a leading contender at a track he relishes. Simply Blue can't be discounted after his recent AW success but ASIAN JOURNEY has been threatening to win a small race this year and he should get a good pace to aim at this time.[Paul Smith] Page 5 spotlightcatterick 22.04.26

Rosenpur can go well on his return to action, while Aberama Gold (second choice) looks set to make another bold bid. That said, DORNEY LAKE has been running himself into form on the AW this year and he looks extremely well treated back on his preferred surface. Yorkshire Glory flopped when returned to turf at Pontefract yesterday.[Paul Smith] Page 6 spotlightcatterick 22.04.26

Course regular Stellarmasterpiece and Free Pic (second choice) know how to get the job done but do need to prove their stamina for this far. In the circumstances it might pay to side with REGAL GLORY, who looked at home over this distance when runner-up last time. Rock Armour can also feature.[Richard Russell] Page 7
